title: Home Purchase Financing Payoff Statement — Calculation of the Payoff Amount and Good-Through Date
content:
**Payoff statement clause — Home Purchase Financing**

**Payoff amount.** The payoff amount is the unpaid principal, plus the payoff interest, plus fees owed, plus the lien release fee, plus the statement fee, less suspense funds, rounded half up to the cent once on that sum; the escrow balance is not netted and is refunded separately after payoff.

**Good-through date.** The good-through date is the statement date plus the good-through period plus the weekend roll, in calendar days. The good-through period is the program's payoff good-through days; the weekend roll is zero.

**Payoff interest days.** The payoff interest days are the calendar days from the due date of the last installment paid to the good-through date, counting the good-through date and not that due date.

**Payoff interest.** The payoff interest is the unpaid principal times the note rate divided by 100, divided by 365, times the payoff interest days, rounded half up to the cent.

**Fees.** The lien release fee is zero. The statement fee is the program's payoff statement fee.

### Worked statement (hypothetical loan; program good-through days taken as 15 and statement fee as 0.00)

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Statement date | 2026-05-04 |
| Good-through date (2026-05-04 plus 15 days) | 2026-05-19 |
| Due date of the last installment paid | 2026-05-01 |
| Payoff interest days (2026-05-02 through 2026-05-19) | 18 |
| Unpaid principal | 40000.00 |
| Payoff interest (40000.00 times 9.00 divided by 100, divided by 365, times 18) | 177.53424…, rounded to 177.53 |
| Fees owed | 25.00 |
| Lien release fee | 0.00 |
| Statement fee | 0.00 |
| Suspense funds | 100.00 |
| Payoff amount | 40102.53 |

The escrow balance of the same loan, whatever it is, is not part of the 40102.53; it is refunded after payoff.
